statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-95839 (GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f, GO-2026-7007): containerd panics while computing referrer labels for a child descriptor that carries the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest, so pulling or importing a crafted image can crash the process. github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.2.0 to 2.2.9, 2.3.0 to 2.3.6 and 2.4.0 to 2.4.1 are affected, and 2.2.10, 2.3.7 and 2.4.2 fix it: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-7007, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.3.7. The fix skips such digests in SetChildrenMappedLabels in core/images/handlers.go; the release/2.3 commit is https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/2181d7baa2a303ea2082e5c0f1a7697787b61ef2 and the release/2.2 commit is https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/2455fec2f7bfa63adb1f993c63ba0cea9cdedb8c, and the Go vulnerability database lists core/images.SetChildrenLabels and SetChildrenMappedLabels as the affected functions. We read every build-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 91 versions, 2.6.4-r0 to the current 2.30.0-r0, each for x86_64 and aarch64 except 2.6.4-r0, which is published for aarch64 only, and each download matched its repository index checksum. Version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index; the repository serves one copy, which matches one of those entries, and that copy was read. Each package holds one file, the Go program /usr/bin/build. For every build we read the Go build information and the function table (pclntab), which contains runtime.main in every one, and we ran a byte search over every program. The Go build information of /usr/bin/build lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2, at v2.2.0 to v2.3.6 before 2.29.1-r1 and v2.3.7 from 2.29.1-r1 on, but the linker kept none of the vulnerable code: no function table of any program in any build contains SetChildrenLabels, SetChildrenMappedLabels or any closure inlined from them, or any other function of the core/images package, and a byte search of every program finds no containerd/containerd/v2/core/images. name and neither function name. As a check, the same reader finds core/images.SetChildrenLabels, SetChildrenMappedLabels and SetChildrenMappedLabels.func1 in a test program we built for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 against the vulnerable github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 v2.3.6 with inlining disabled, and the byte search finds the SetChildrenMappedLabels name in the same program built with default inlining, where the function table no longer lists it, which shows both searches work.

CVE-2026-95839 (GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f): containerd's image handling panics when a child descriptor in a manifest carries the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest, so pulling or importing such an image through containerd's transfer service, including CRI PullImage requests, crashes the containerd daemon. github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.2.0 to 2.2.9, 2.3.0 to 2.3.6 and 2.4.0 to 2.4.1 are affected, and it is fixed in 2.2.10, 2.3.7 and 2.4.2: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/a2eb01f667b320b00ec218216f26f7b79197d4cd (release/2.4, in v2.4.2), https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/2181d7baa2a303ea2082e5c0f1a7697787b61ef2 (release/2.3, in v2.3.7). The advisory lists no affected symbols; the fix changes only core/images.SetChildrenMappedLabels, which core/images.SetChildrenLabels wraps, so that a malformed child digest is skipped instead of being sliced into a referrer label. We read the Go build information and the function table (pclntab) of the docker-buildx program, /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx, the only file each package installs, in every published docker-cli-buildx package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (0.33.0-r1 to 0.39.1-r0; 28 aarch64 and 27 x86_64 builds), each checked against the repository index checksum. The function table of every build contains runtime.main, which confirms the listing works on that file. The build information lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 v2.2.2 to v2.4.2, but the program does not contain the vulnerable code: no entry in any build's function table is SetChildrenMappedLabels, SetChildrenLabels or a closure named after either, while the same tables list other core/images functions, such as core/images.Dispatch and core/images.Children, in every build. A string search of four of these programs (Alpine 3.23 x86_64 0.33.0-r1 and aarch64 0.37.2-r0, Alpine 3.24 x86_64 0.38.1-r0 and aarch64 0.39.1-r0) also finds neither function name nor the fix's log message, while it does find core/images.Dispatch. As a control, the same function-table search of /usr/bin/dockerd in the DHI docker-engine 29.10.0-r1 package for Alpine 3.24 (x86_64) finds closures of the inlined SetChildrenMappedLabels, such as client.(*Client).fetch.SetChildrenMappedLabels.func5.

CVE-2026-95839 (GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f): containerd's image handling panics when a child descriptor in a manifest carries the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest, so pulling or importing such an image through containerd's transfer service, including CRI PullImage requests, crashes the containerd daemon. github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.2.0 to 2.2.9, 2.3.0 to 2.3.6 and 2.4.0 to 2.4.1 are affected, and it is fixed in 2.2.10, 2.3.7 and 2.4.2: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/a2eb01f667b320b00ec218216f26f7b79197d4cd (release/2.4, in v2.4.2). This package contains no Go program. We unpacked every published docker-dind-dev package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, 29.7.2-r0 to 29.10.0-r3 (59 builds, each for x86_64 and aarch64), after verifying each against its index checksum: the payload of each is the three shell scripts docker-entrypoint.sh, dockerd-entrypoint.sh and modprobe (29.7.2-r1 ships modprobe as /usr/lib/docker-dind/modprobe.sh), plus, from 29.9.2-r9 on, an SPDX document, opt/docker/sbom/docker-dind-runtime/.spdx.docker-dind-runtime.json, describing the programs of the separate packages it depends on. That document lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.4.2, and in 29.9.2-r9 to 29.9.2-r12 also 2.4.1, as a module of those programs, but it is a JSON text file, not code. No build contains an ELF, PE or Mach-O file, a static archive or any other compiled program. github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 reaches an image only inside those separately packaged programs, such as the Docker Engine, containerd and Buildx packages, which are assessed as their own owners.

statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-95839 (GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f): in containerd 2.2.0 to 2.2.9, 2.3.0 to 2.3.6 and 2.4.0 to 2.4.1, image manifest processing can meet a child descriptor that carries the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest; the code that builds the referrer garbage-collection label slices the digest without validating it and panics, so pulling or importing such an image can crash the process. It is fixed in containerd 2.2.10, 2.3.7 and 2.4.2 by "images: skip malformed digests when computing referrer labels", which changes SetChildrenMappedLabels in core/images/handlers.go and adds the log messages "skipping child with invalid digest for referrer label" and "skipping child with digest too short for referrer label": https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/2181d7baa2a303ea2082e5c0f1a7697787b61ef2 (release/2.3 branch, first released in v2.3.7), https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.3.7. Read /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-scout, the only ELF file in the package, in every docker-scout-cli-plugin package published in the DHI Alpine 3.24 repository: 1.25.0-r0, 1.25.0-r1, 1.29.0-r0 and 1.30.0-r0, for x86_64 and aarch64, each verified against the repository index checksum. Every build embeds github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 v2.3.6, inside the affected range, and its Go function names include core/images.SetChildrenMappedLabels and SetChildrenLabels, while neither log message the fix adds is present. No published build carries the fix.

CVE-2026-95839 (GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f): in containerd 2.2.0 to 2.2.9, 2.3.0 to 2.3.6 and 2.4.0 to 2.4.1, image manifest processing can meet a child descriptor that carries the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest; the code that builds the referrer garbage-collection label slices the digest without validating it and panics, so pulling or importing such an image can crash the process. It is fixed in containerd 2.2.10, 2.3.7 and 2.4.2 by "images: skip malformed digests when computing referrer labels", which changes SetChildrenMappedLabels in core/images/handlers.go and adds the log messages "skipping child with invalid digest for referrer label" and "skipping child with digest too short for referrer label": https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/a2eb01f667b320b00ec218216f26f7b79197d4cd (release/2.4 branch, first released in v2.4.2), https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.4.2. Read every package built from the DHI docker source for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (docker, docker-engine, docker-cli and its other subpackages): 39 builds, 29.4.0-r1 to 29.10.0-r1. docker-cli is published for x86_64 and aarch64 in every build, and so is docker-engine except 29.4.3-r0, which is published for aarch64 only; 29.10.0-r1 is so far published only as docker, docker-cli and docker-engine. The Go programs are /usr/bin/dockerd and /usr/bin/docker-proxy in docker-engine and /usr/bin/docker in docker-cli, each dynamically linked against musl (dockerd in some builds also against libnftables); /usr/bin/docker-init is a link to /sbin/tini-static from another package; the other subpackages hold the dockerd-rootless script, OpenRC and systemd service files, a modules-load.d configuration file, shell completions and documentation, with no ELF, PE or Mach-O files, and the docker package itself installs no files. Each package was verified against the repository index checksum, and the Go function names of every ELF program were read from its function table (dockerd, docker-proxy and docker carry no ELF symbol table before 29.10.0-r1). Only dockerd contains containerd code: in every build its function names include github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/core/images.SetChildrenMappedLabels and SetChildrenLabels, and neither function is in docker-proxy or docker: docker-proxy's module list never names github.com/containerd/containerd/v2, and no docker/cli release from v29.4.0 to v29.10.0 vendors it (https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/v29.10.0/vendor.mod). dockerd's build information records github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 v2.2.2 to v2.4.1 in 29.4.0-r1 to 29.9.0-r1, inside the affected ranges, and neither log message the fix adds is present in those builds; from 29.9.1-r0 on it records v2.4.2 and both messages are present. The range ends at 29.9.1-r0.

CVE-2026-95839: containerd panics while computing referrer labels for a child descriptor that carries the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest (core/images SetChildrenMappedLabels), so pulling or importing a crafted image crashes the process. It is fixed in containerd 2.2.10, 2.3.7 and 2.4.2 (https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f; release/2.3 fix commit https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/2181d7baa2a303ea2082e5c0f1a7697787b61ef2, release/2.2 fix commit https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/2455fec2f7bfa63adb1f993c63ba0cea9cdedb8c). Read every published trivy-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 38 builds, 0.69.1-r0 to the current 0.74.0-r12, each for x86_64 and aarch64, each package checked against the index checksum. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 that keeps its Go symbol table. The Go build information, the same on both architectures in each build, lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.2.0 to 2.3.6 in builds before 0.74.0-r12, which the advisory lists as affected, and 2.3.7 in 0.74.0-r12, which it does not. In the function table of every build (go tool nm), the SetChildrenMappedLabels closure is present, inlined into the containerd client's Import and fetch functions (client.(*Client).Import.SetChildrenMappedLabels.func5, client.(*Client).fetch.SetChildrenMappedLabels.func5), so the vulnerable code is linked and the FIXED range follows the module version.

The same search finds both functions in dockerd from the DHI docker packages, which does link them.

Read every published docker-compose-plugin package in the DHI Debian 13 repository: 41 builds, 5.3.1-2 to the current 5.8.0-6, each for amd64 and arm64; no debug-symbol packages are published for this source. Each holds one program, /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose, a statically linked Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0. Each package was verified against the repository index checksum. The program embeds github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 (v2.2.5 to v2.4.2) and links its core/images package (Dispatch is among its Go function names in every build), but neither github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/core/images.SetChildrenMappedLabels nor SetChildrenLabels, the function the fix changes and its wrapper, is among the Go function names of any of the 82 programs, so the vulnerable label code is not compiled in. The same search finds both functions in dockerd from the DHI docker packages, which does link them.
